# yaml-test-suite

Source: <https://github.com/yaml/yaml-test-suite>, `data` branch at commit
`6ad3d2c62885d82fc349026c136ef560838fdf3d` (2022-01-17), the release data
generated from the suite's sources. The licence file `License` (MIT) is
taken from the `main` branch at commit
`da267a5c4782e7361e82889e76c0dc7df0e1e870`.

Vendored: for every case directory, the files `===` (the case name),
`in.yaml`, `in.json` and `error` where present, unchanged.
